task_completion.description: Navigate to the 'Users' or 'Profile' section in the WordPress dashboard to manage application passwords.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The WordPress dashboard showing the 'Edit User' or 'Profile' page for the admin user.

task_completion.description: Create a new Application Password named 'MobileApp_iOS'.
task_completion.visual_evidence: A screenshot showing the name 'MobileApp_iOS' entered into the application password field and the resulting generated password displayed in a success box.

task_completion.description: Save the credentials in 'admin:PASSWORD' format to /home/ga/mobile_api_credentials.txt.
task_completion.visual_evidence: A terminal window or text editor showing the file /home/ga/mobile_api_credentials.txt containing the admin username and the generated password.

task_completion.description: Initiate the creation of a new post with the correct title.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The WordPress post editor open with the title 'App Configuration Endpoint' entered.
The post settings sidebar showing 'Visibility: Private' selected or a confirmation dialog for publishing a private post.

task_completion.description: Insert the specific JSON data into the post body.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The post editor showing the JSON block with app_version '2.4.1', maintenance_mode false, and the specified features and api_base.

integrity.description: The agent should use the WordPress web interface to create the password and post, rather than direct database manipulation.
integrity.visual_evidence: Screenshots showing the agent clicking buttons and typing within the WordPress browser interface.

integrity.description: The agent must use the actual generated password, not a placeholder like 'PASSWORD' or '1234'.
integrity.visual_evidence: The credentials file and post content should contain the specific values generated during the session.

integrity.description: The post must be created through the WordPress editor, not just simulated.
integrity.visual_evidence: The 'Post published' or 'Post updated' notification appearing in the WordPress UI.

privileged_info_for_vlm: The Application Password must be named 'MobileApp_iOS'. The credentials file must be at /home/ga/mobile_api_credentials.txt in 'admin:PASSWORD' format. The post title must be 'App Configuration Endpoint', its status must be 'Private', and the JSON must contain: app_version: '2.4.1', maintenance_mode: false, features: ['push_notifications', 'dark_mode', 'offline_sync'], and api_base: 'https://api.nimbustech.com/v2'.
